messages:
eva_sdr: hey team, eva here — second week SDR. stuck on two things: HubSpot shows 'no access to sequences' and I can't get the Dialpad Chrome extension to autolog calls. also would love the quick objection scripts and inbound playbook. who do i ping?
jen_salesops: welcome back! i'll sort HubSpot perms. confirm email? is it eva@redwood.ai? dialer probs often Chrome-ext blocking; try incognito to rule that out.
rachel_enablement: linking inbound playbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/inbound-playbook and objection snippets PDF: https://drive.redwood.ai/sales/objections.pdf. short tip: open with "one-line value prop + qualification question".
alec_it: hi eva — confirm email and if you accepted Okta. if Dialpad extension still blocked, send me the extension console logs and i'll check policy.
onboarding-bot: automated checklist: add eva to 'sdr-sequences' HubSpot team, confirm Dialpad extension policy, share playbook links.
eva_sdr: yes eva@redwood.ai, okta accepted. incognito didn't help; extension shows "Unable to access microphone" and HubSpot sequence tab is missing.
jen_salesops: grant sent — added you to 'sdr-sequences' at 1750300200. refresh and check.
alec_it: microphone permission is browser-level. I pushed a policy fix at 1750300300 that relaxes mic access for dialer extension. try restarting Chrome. if still blocked, run: chrome://extensions > inspect views > background page and paste console.
eva_sdr: permissions fixed after restart — sequence tab visible and dialer mic works. thank you! deck looks great, will run through scripts and shadow calls today.
jen_salesops: sweet. follow-up: i'll add you to the weekly SDR cadence channel and invite you to tomorrow's live roleplay. ping me if any HubSpot fields look off.
eva_sdr: will do. quick note: when i logged a test call the activity showed up after ~2 minutes — is that normal?
jen_salesops: yes small sync delay (30–120s). if it's >10m ping me and i'll check webhook retries.
eva_sdr: noted. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
